**342 ****∶**** ?**

Hence, **"7"** is correct answer.

**Statements:**

Some cities are monuments.

All monuments are civilizations.

All streets are cities.

**Conclusions:**

I. No city is a civilization.

II. Some cities are civilizations.

III. Some monuments are cities.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92e592cc3080459cea3878d10dca9277f497473a296018746c3ba63f8fe8cdb1.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No city is a civilization → False (Because some cities are monuments and all monuments are civilizations, so definitely some cities are also civilizations)

II. Some cities are civilizations → True (Because some cities are monuments and all monuments are civilizations, so definitely some cities are also civilizations)

III. Some monuments are cities → True (Because some cities are monuments,so definitely some monuments are also cities ) 

Hence, “**Only conclusions II and III follow**".

questions.question:

2. Germany

3. Frankfurt

4. Universe

questions.solution:
The logical and meaningful order of the given words is as follows:

LOGIC: The words have been arranged according to the size.

**3. Frankfurt:** Frankfurt is the city in Germany.

**2. Germany:** Germany is the country in Europe continent.

**1. Europe:** Europe is a continent in the world.

**5. World:** World is a part of the universe.

**4. Universe:** Universe is bigger than all of them.

Hence, "**3, 2, 1, 5, 4**" is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a certain code language, SIXER is coded as 75. How will COLOUR be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**Code = Sum of the positional values of the letters**

**SIXER **→

 
• S(19) + I(9) + X(24) + E(5) + R(18) = 19 + 9 + 24 + 5 + 18 = 75

Similarly,

**COLOUR →**

 
• C(3) + O(15) + L(12) + O(15) + U(21) + R(18) = 3 + 15 + 12 + 15 + 21 + 18 = **84**

Hence, **‘COLOUR’** will be written as **“84”.**

questions.question:
If 'A @ B' means 'A is the mother of B' and 'A % B' means 'A is the brother of B', then which of the following statements is correct for the given expression?

G @ P % U % V @ R

options.text: U is the father of R.
G is the mother of V.
R is the daughter of G.
U is the sister of R.

questions.solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/FyD9L3PCPvZsHa5nynlMPf_fzf_aXK9tKopSaDWxBYVwFRo-6fzjiv7HQG28YUhFJ0nLGj9_hEV_JqW5NQsWS_FX2dnhd3UTkTZ5DE4dKFyqgfFDku2-8QBz2pL7YIeD6iwR5lii] 

Given:

'A @ B' means 'A is the mother of B'

'A % B' means 'A is the brother of B'

Let us first decode the given symbols and then draw a family tree.

 
 

 
 
**A is**

 
 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

 
 
 
@

 
 
 
%

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 

 
 
**of B**

 
 
 

Now break the code **‘G @ P % U % V @ R’**

**1) G @ P**

‘G @ P’ means 'G is mother of P'.

**2) P % U**

'P % U' means 'P is brother of U'.

**3) U % V**

'U % V' means 'U is brother of V'.

**4) V @ R**

'V @ R' means 'V is mother of R'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f9cac2ee4bd7040e0cbf8d6e2d0dd78273d4ee8f9c0557f1e7037de8affb207.png] 

Now, check all the options

1) U is the father of R → False (U is the maternal uncle of R)

**2) G is the mother of V ****→ True**

3) R is the daughter of G → False (R is the grandson / granddaughter of G)

4) U is the sister of R → False (U is the maternal uncle of R)

Hence, **“G is the mother of V”** is the correct answer.

'A @ B' means 'A is the son of B'.

'A & B' means 'A is the brother of B'.

'A # B' means 'A is the wife of B'.

'A + B' means 'A is the father of B'.

Let us first decode the given symbols and then draw a family tree.

 
 

 
 
**A is**

 
 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

 
 
 
@

 
 
 
&

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
^

 
 
 
+

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
Son

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Wife

 
 
 
Husband

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 

 
 
**of B**

 
 
 

Given: **‘Y + M & T # J @ H # R @ P ^ Q’**

**1) Y + M**

‘Y + M’ means 'Y is father of M'.

**2) M & T**

'M & T' means 'M is brother of T'.

**3) T # J**

'T # J' means 'T is wife of J'.

**4) J @ H**

'J @ H' means 'J is son of H'.

**5) H # R**

'H # R’ means 'H is wife of R'.

**6) R @ P**

'R @ P’ means 'R is son of P'

**7) P ^ Q’**

'P ^ Q’ means 'P is husband of Q'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbd042d6d2bb903956b13f5ca95b5f60ac9481d6bc9eb2c4fc2cc9d5f13d08c4.png] 

Now, check all the options

1) P is the maternal grandfather of J → False (P is the paternal grandfather of J)

**2) Y is the father-in-law of J ****→ True (****Y is the father-in-law of J****)**

3) R is the father of T → False (R is the father-in-law of T)

4) Q is the mother of H → False (Q is the mother-in-law of H)

Hence, **“Y is the father-in-law of J”** is the correct answer.
